BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to estate distribution documents; amending RCW19.295.010; and adding a new section to chapter 19.295 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 19.295.010 and 2007 c 67 s 2 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The definitions in this section apply throughout this chapterunless the context clearly requires otherwise. (1) "Market" or "marketing" includes every offer, contract, oragreement to prepare or gather information for the preparation of, orto provide, individualized advice about an estate distributiondocument. (2) "Estate distribution document" means any one or more of thefollowing documents, instruments, or writings prepared, or intended tobe prepared, for a specific person or as marketing materials fordistribution to any person, other than documents, instruments,writings, or marketing materials relating to a payable on death accountestablished under RCW 30.22.040(9) or a transfer on death accountestablished under chapter 21.35 RCW: p. 1 SHB 3012 (a) Last will and testament or any writing, however designated,that is intended to have the same legal effect as a last will andtestament, and any codicil thereto; (b) Revocable and irrevocable inter vivos trusts and any instrumentwhich purports to transfer any of the trustor's current and/or futureinterest in real or personal property thereto; (c) Agreement that fixes the terms and provisions of the sale of adecedent's interest in any real or personal property at or followingthe date of the decedent's death. (3) "Financial institution" means a bank holding company registeredunder federal law, ((or)) a bank, trust company, mutual savings bank,savings bank, savings and loan association, or credit union organizedunder state or federal law, or a securities broker-dealer licensedunder state law, or any affiliate, subsidiary, officer, or employee ofa financial institution. (4) "Person" means any natural person, corporation, partnership,limited liability company, firm, or association. (5) "Securities brokerdealer" means a securities brokerdealercurrently registered in the state of Washington pursuant to chapter21.20 RCW.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 19.295 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: This chapter does not apply to any financial institution orsecurities brokerdealer provided that their activities are consistentwith and in compliance with chapter 2.48 RCW and court rules adopted bythe state supreme court, including general rule 24 and admission topractice rules, as hereby enacted or subsequently amended.
